lines: Your phone pings, another task appears.
Your mind thinks saying no is selfish.
You worry they’ll think you’re flaky.
When you finally say no, they stop.
They feel the gap you created.
They realize they miss the calm, not you.
Your energy belongs only to you.
Protect it, or they’ll drain you.
Follow for more daily psychology that can change your life.
